headline: 1,076 dead as measles outbreak kills 11 in 48 hours in Bangladesh
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports a surge in cases, with 1,270 new suspected and confirmed infections identified in just 24 hours.
details: The measles outbreak in Bangladesh has reached a critical point, with the total death toll climbing to 1,076. In a alarming surge, 11 deaths were reported within a 48-hour window.
According to a regular report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) released on Wednesday afternoon, the situation remains severe across the country.
In the last 24 hours alone, 1,270 people have been identified as suspected or confirmed measles patients.
The DGHS continues to monitor the situation as the number of infections and fatalities continue to rise rapidly.

headline: Water transport fares raised by 7.54% following fuel price hike
summary: The minimum fare has increased from Tk 32 to Tk 35, following a decision by the Ministry of Shipping.
details: The government has increased water transport fares by 7.54 percent in response to rising fuel costs. Shipping Minister Shaikh Rabiul Alam announced the decision today after a meeting with stakeholders at the Ministry of Shipping.
The minimum fare for passengers has risen from Tk 32 to Tk 35. This adjustment follows a recent fuel price increase of approximately 17.39 percent.

Water transport operators had initially sought a 25 percent increase, later lowering their demand to 15 percent. They cited higher management costs, the rise in the US dollar, and the increased cost of spare parts as primary reasons.

Shipping Minister Rabiul Alam stated that while there was justification for some of the operators' demands, the final 7.54 percent increase was set to balance operator costs with passenger affordability and convenience.
